title: Hypermaps
tagline: Publicly Collaborative Correlationally Iterative Optionally Private LLM Organizational Environments

prizes.title: Best Application Built on Hypergraph (Knowledge Graph Framework)

description: Hypergraph as the database and backend layer, and authentification layer. We have rewritten the hypergaph template from Vite to Next JS which allows us to have serverless function and an integration with Vercel AI SDK which means we can have streaming on the front end. One note about the Hypergraph is that all the chats and all the entities stored in it exist in a 2D space where the coordinates are made to persist along with the conversational data. We can perform all the crud operations and sync them to the hypergraph.
how_its_made: Mind Flow is a private and / or optionally shared or public environment for visually organizing LLM responses. Our environment features The Graph's Hypergraph environment and utilities to Mind Map customized work and idea flows. Mind Flow aims to allow users to connect LLM to innovative concepts and never before realized correlations with our organizational data flows.
